sourceProbe: Real vitest 5.0.1 output: `pnpm exec vitest run test/stats.test.ts --reporter=junit|json --outputFile=<scratch>` (exit 0) copied into fixtures/b21/pass with hostname and absolute repo path sanitized.

checks.cmd: pnpm --filter @rat-stack/core exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json (filtered to local-test/b21)

events.test.result: one per report file: tests, passed, failed, errors, skipped, durationMs (source-reported), failingTests (<=25 names, <=200 chars), status, commandSessionId, joinAttribution strong|provisional|unassigned, joinMethod declared-report|time-window|none, occurredAtMethod
events.command.run: one per dx.local-test.command.v1 record: commandName, redacted commandDisplay (<=200 chars), exitCode|null, durationMs (derived)|null, isTestCommand, status passed|failed|unknown; identity.sessionId

gaps: No producer writes dx.local-test.command.v1 JSONL yet (a `dx run -- <cmd>` wrapper is outside B21 scope); command joins only work when that file is supplied.
Only explicitly selected report files/directories (non-recursive) are imported; test runs that write no JUnit/JSON report are not observed.
JUnit timestamps without a timezone are left unavailable (null), not guessed.
No per-test rework/flake history yet (re-runs are separate test.result events; a metric can diff failingTests across runs).
Not registered: integration owner (A02/A07) must add localTestCollector to the registry and expose `dx collect --source local-test --input <path>`.
